scope: Forty-champion enrichment batch 07D-1: original conditional field notes based on linked references; not independent gameplay testing.

decisions.title: Build Cunning while keeping Specials controllable
decisions.text: Green Goblin develops Cunning with his power progression, but banking power indefinitely can let the defender become dangerous. Check the visible meter and bait a manageable opponent Special before making the next attack decision.

decisions.title: Choose SP1 only when its control has value
decisions.text: SP1 can provide a Power Drain opportunity and Weakness rather than a guaranteed complete shutoff. Confirm the effect landed before continuing pressure, especially when an enemy Special would be unsafe.

decisions.title: Check Incinerate and Poison protection separately
decisions.text: SP2 can supply Incinerate and a chance for Poison, which are different damage effects with separate immunity checks. Do not count on the chance-based application as part of every damage calculation.

decisions.title: Develop Pacifism without feeding dangerous Specials
decisions.text: Groot can gain Pacifism as the opponent gains and spends power, but provoking dangerous attacks only for resources creates avoidable risk. Use a defender whose Special pattern you can consistently handle.

decisions.title: Use Fury before the conversion window expires
decisions.text: Pacifism can convert into a short Fury and Cruelty opportunity. Observe the actual active buffs and remaining time before launching a Special, rather than holding power until the bonuses disappear.

decisions.title: Weigh SP2 healing against immediate progress
decisions.text: SP2 offers missing-health recovery while SP1 serves a different damage objective. When healing is blocked or the defender is nearly defeated, a safer faster finish can be more valuable than building to the recovery option.

decisions.title: Track Crowd Excitement before committing to SMASH
decisions.text: Hulk (Ragnarok) develops Crowd Excitement through combat and gains a specific SMASH opportunity. Confirm readiness and establish a safe Heavy opening before committing to the hit.

decisions.title: Spend power on the control effect the fight needs
decisions.text: SP1 can offer Heal Block and SP2 can provide Enervate, addressing different threats. Assess whether the defender is healing or gaining too much power before choosing which Special to use.

decisions.title: Use SP3 for a longer-fight resource plan
decisions.text: SP3 can accelerate Crowd Excitement, but saving three bars is costly when the opponent is close to defeat. Compare remaining health, node pressure, and safety before choosing the slower setup.
